overview.text: Google DeepMind is Google's unified AI research and product lab, formed in April 2023 by merging DeepMind -- a London AI lab founded in 2010 by Demis Hassabis, Shane Legg and Mustafa Suleyman and acquired by Google in 2014 -- with Google's own Google Brain team, under Hassabis as CEO.

citations.quote: Build AI responsibly to benefit humanity

what_theyve_done.text: DeepMind was founded in the UK in 2010 and built early deep-reinforcement-learning systems including AlphaGo, while Google Brain, started in 2011, invented the Transformer architecture underlying most modern large language models.

citations.quote: Google DeepMind brings together two of the world's leading AI labs

what_theyve_done.text: Google merged DeepMind and Google Brain into a single organization, Google DeepMind, in April 2023 to consolidate its AI research after the rise of ChatGPT.

In May 2026 it released Gemini 3.5 Flash, the first model in a new 3.5 family built for agentic and coding workloads, shipping at once across the free Gemini app, Search's AI Mode, the Gemini API, the new Antigravity developer platform and Gemini Enterprise.

citations.quote: outperforming Gemini 3.1 Pro on challenging coding and agentic benchmarks

what_theyve_done.text: On June 30, 2026 it released two generative-media models, Nano Banana 2 Lite and Gemini Omni Flash: a fast, low-cost text-to-image model producing images in about four seconds, and a video-generation and conversational video-editing model, both rolling out across Google AI Studio, the Gemini API and consumer surfaces including Search's AI Mode, Google Photos and Google Flow.

citations.quote: The real magic happens when you chain these models together

what_theyve_done.text: On July 16, 2026 it published a joint bioresilience approach with Isomorphic Labs covering AI-assisted prevention, detection, and response to biological threats, citing more than 15 partnerships built over the prior year with governments, biosecurity organizations, and researchers, and drawing on tools including AlphaFold, AlphaGenome, and the SynthID watermarking system.

citations.quote: AI is a critical tool for our response

what_theyve_done.text: On July 21, 2026 it released Gemini 3.6 Flash, taking over as its main workhorse tier from 3.5 Flash, alongside a cheaper Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite and a Gemini 3.5 Flash Cyber restricted to governments and trusted partners. Gemini 3.6 Flash handles text, image, audio, and video input on a 1-million-token context window with 64,000-token max output.

citations.quote: Best for token efficiency in coding, knowledge work, and multimodal tasks

strengths.text: Google DeepMind combines two of the field's longest-running research groups -- one that pioneered deep reinforcement learning, one that invented the Transformer -- under a single research and product organization.

Its Gemini 3.5 Flash release runs roughly four times faster on output tokens per second than prior frontier models by Google's own benchmark comparison, while also beating its own Gemini 3.1 Pro on coding and agentic tasks.

citations.quote: 4 times faster than other frontier models

current_focus.text: Google DeepMind's current public focus is Gemini 3.6 Flash, which took over the main workhorse role from 3.5 Flash on July 21, 2026, oriented toward agentic workflows and coding rather than general chat and distributed broadly through Google's consumer and developer surfaces at once. A larger Gemini 3.5 Pro sibling remains in partner testing with no announced release date.

citations.quote: Our workhorse model that reduces output token usage by 17% compared to 3.5 Flash

roadmap.text: As of July 21, 2026, Google says Gemini 3.5 Pro is still in partner testing with no announced release date, walking back its own earlier one-month estimate.

citations.quote: currently testing with partners and we plan to make it broadly available

roadmap.text: Google says it has started its most ambitious pre-training run yet, for Gemini 4.

citations.quote: started our most ambitious pre-training run yet, for Gemini 4
